texto: This is the short project text: two or three paragraphs explaining what the project is about, what problem it solves and how. The title and the images are what matter most, so there is no need to write at length.

To publish a real project: copy this entry into the four language files, change the "id", the title and the text, and drop the images into src/assets/img/proyectos/. Delete this example entry once it is no longer needed.
